posts.title: Barter Street - Low Level City-crawling in the City State
posts.description: I need to get this out of my head before it strangles me. Thanks to FelineAvian for beginning this obsession. Takes place in the City State of the Invincible Overlord Holme Alone / Baker Street style, level 3 max. non-monstrous NPCs are demoted to levels 1-3. Uses chainmail instead of d&d for combat, but not rolling damage as advised in od&d. Hits kill or drain a level if you are higher than level

posts.title: Battle For Phaedra Grand Retrospective - Introduction
posts.description: It's time to regale you all with my biggest rpg experiment: My 3-month-long cataphracts game that was the continuation of my 'home game' Phaedra. This post is how the game was conceived, as many of the original game play docs as I can remember, and some notes about how some of it went. A Warning Starting in The Factions and Starting Commanders , I link to cloned versions of the starting documents
